tier_description: Cross-Domain Constraint Checking — questions that cannot be answered correctly using only one domain; require synthesizing information from 2+ domains simultaneously

category_descriptions.A: Prerequisites + Schedule (10 questions) — cross-check prereq eligibility AND Spring 2026 course availability/conflicts
category_descriptions.B: Program Requirements + Course Availability (10 questions) — determine if required courses exist in the relevant semester
category_descriptions.C: Policy + Student Situation (10 questions) — apply policy rules while accounting for the student's academic standing and course load
category_descriptions.D: Multi-Requirement Interaction (10 questions) — courses satisfying multiple requirements; double-counting rules; dual minor/concentration constraints
category_descriptions.E: Graduation Feasibility (10 questions) — senior/5th-year students checking if remaining requirements can be completed given scheduling and policy constraints

schema.persona_id: Persona identifier (always present for T3 questions)
schema.question: Natural-language question requiring cross-domain constraint checking
schema.answer: Correct answer (left blank for manual completion)
schema.domains_required: List of 2+ domains needed to answer correctly
schema.domain_contributions: Map of domain → what specific information that domain provides
schema.key_facts: List of critical facts from each domain that must be retrieved
schema.wrong_if_single_domain: What incorrect conclusion is reached using only one domain
schema.common_mistake: Typical error an advising system might make on this question
schema.reasoning_chain: Ordered list of reasoning steps required to reach the correct answer

quality_notes: All 50 questions require information from 2 or more domains
All 5 categories have exactly 10 questions each
All 50 questions are persona-grounded (exceeds the ≥45 requirement)
Answers left blank for manual verification and completion
wrong_if_single_domain field documents the failure mode when only one domain is consulted
reasoning_chain provides an ordered sequence of cross-domain inference steps
Key personas on academic warning (P-009, P-013, P-046) appear in multiple Category C questions
Spring 2026 schedule data used for all schedule-related constraints
